attchmntText: Jayshree Tea & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Jay Shree Tea and Industries Limited filed extracts of newspaper publications regarding the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended on 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at their meeting held on 13th November 2026. The results were published on 14th November 2026 in Business Standard and Arthik Lipi. The announcement also includes a section titled Change of Name containing multiple individual declarations. These declarations confirm that various individuals have changed their names or corrected spelling errors in official records through affidavits sworn before Notaries Public or Magistrates in West Bengal during November 2026. The company’s stock codes are 509115 on the Bombay Stock Exchange and 10000036 on the Calcutta Stock Exchange.

attchmntText: Jayshree Tea & Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jay Shree Tea and Industries Limited filed unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results in a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The results were subjected to a limited review by the company auditors. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 47,234 lakhs compared to 45,045 lakhs in the previous year. Net profit for the half year was 1,136 lakhs, versus a net loss of 2,183 lakhs in the prior period. Segment revenue included 24,736 lakhs from Tea, 8,689 lakhs from P&K Fertilisers, and 13,809 lakhs from Sugar. Total assets stood at 1,01,192 lakhs as of 30th September 2026.
